summary: Narrow kerb where cars park, but houses sit 12-20 m off behind hedges.

best_section.where: Douglas Street west kerb, below the bend where the parked cars sit

drivers.seclusion: Houses 12-15 m away on the kerb side behind dense planting; more homes across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with cars already parked on this kerb; narrow, so a van takes most of the width of the parking space.
drivers.convention: Cars park along it; a No Stopping Any Time sign sits near the top junction, so check the kerb before stopping.

flags: Steep: about 7% grade over best section (max 10.4% elsewhere)
No Stopping Any Time sign nearby, near the junction at the top end
sun_shade: Heavily shaded by trees on the west side; open to afternoon sun from the west in gaps.
cannot_judge: Exact reach of the No Stopping sign
